title: Docusaurus blog authors
description: blog/authors.yml: the authors a post can name in its authors key, by key.

name.description: The author's name, shown on their posts.

title.description: A short line under the name, such as their role.

url.description: A link on the author's name.

image_url.description: The author's picture: a path or URL.

page.description: true gives the author a page listing their posts.

socials.description: Social accounts, by network name, such as github: their-login.
